headlines.description: Arsenal's bid to win the Champions League for the first time in their 140-year history ended in heartbreak after a penalty shootout defeat to Paris Saint-Germain.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG beat Arsenal on penalties to defend Champions League title

headlines.description: Harry Kane delivered for Bayern Munich on his return from injury, scoring a goal and helping set up another in his team's 2-1 win at Real Madrid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kane gives Bayern 1st-leg edge at Real Madrid

headlines.description: Kai Havertz scored a stoppage-time winner to fire Arsenal to a crucial 1-0 victory against Sporting in the first leg of their Champions League quarterfinal in Lisbon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Havertz rescues Arsenal in 1st-leg win vs. Sporting

headlines.description: Julián Álvarez and Alexander Sørloth struck as Atlético Madrid upset 10-man Barcelona to win the first leg of their Champions League quarterfinal 2-0.
headlines.shortLinkText: Álvarez leads Atleti to 1st-leg edge over Barça

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain dominated Liverpool to emerge with a 2-0 victory that could have been far greater in the first leg of their Champions League quarterfinal.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG dominate shot-shy Liverpool in Paris 1st leg

notes.text: 2nd Leg - Atlético Madrid advance 3-2 on aggregate
notes.headline: 2nd Leg - Atlético Madrid advance 3-2 on aggregate

headlines.description: Atlético Madrid held on after an early charge by Barcelona to reach the Champions League semifinals for the first time in nearly a decade on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barça out of UCL after rally vs. Atlético falls short

notes.text: 2nd Leg - Paris Saint-Germain advance 4-0 on aggregate
notes.headline: 2nd Leg - Paris Saint-Germain advance 4-0 on aggregate

headlines.description: Ousmane Dembélé scored two late goals as Paris Saint-Germain extinguished Liverpool's hopes of a comeback to march into the Champions League semifinals 4-0 on aggregate.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dembélé finishes Liverpool to put PSG in semis

headlines.description: Arsenal secured their place in the semifinals of the Champions League following a 0-0 draw against Sporting CP at the Emirates.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal edge Sporting to set up Atlético semifinal

notes.text: 2nd Leg - Bayern Munich advance 6-4 on aggregate
notes.headline: 2nd Leg - Bayern Munich advance 6-4 on aggregate

headlines.description: Bayern Munich scored two late goals to knock record 15-time European champions Real Madrid out of the Champions League following a thrilling 4-3 win at the Allianz Arena on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bayern oust Madrid in UCL classic; PSG up next

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain and Bayern Munich produced an epic Champions League semifinal as the French holders claimed a 5-4 first-leg victory at Parc des Princes.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG edge Bayern in semifinal 1st-leg classic

headlines.description: Atlético Madrid and Arsenal will head to north London next week with all to play for after a 1-1 draw in Wednesday's Champions League semifinal first leg.
headlines.shortLinkText: Atlético and Arsenal trade penalties in 1st-leg draw

headlines.description: Bukayo Saka scored the decisive goal to send Arsenal to their first Champions League final in 20 years following a 1-0 win against Atletico Madrid at the Emirates Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bukayo Saka fires Arsenal to first Champions League final in 20 years

notes.text: 2nd Leg - Paris Saint-Germain advance 6-5 on aggregate
notes.headline: 2nd Leg - Paris Saint-Germain advance 6-5 on aggregate

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain will play Arsenal in the Champions League final after they drew 1-1 with Bayern Munich in the Allianz Arena to seal a 6-5 aggregate semifinal victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG hold off Bayern Munich to return to UCL final
